name: Splunk IP Search
description: Search Splunk for all events related to a specific IP address across all indexes.
whyUse: Search all Splunk indexes for this IP as source or destination across firewalls, proxies, and authentication logs.
lookFor: Connection counts, geo distribution, success/failure ratios, user agents, internal assets communicating with this IP.
riskNote: Internal tool — no external submission risk.

name: Splunk Domain Search
description: Search Splunk for all events referencing a domain in DNS, proxy, and web filter logs.
whyUse: Pivot on domain across DNS query logs, proxy logs, and email gateway logs to identify scope of exposure.
lookFor: DNS resolution history, users who visited the domain, email recipients, first/last seen timestamps.
riskNote: Internal tool — no external submission risk.

name: Cortex XDR IP Search
description: Search Cortex XDR for endpoint events involving a specific IP address.
whyUse: Identify endpoints that communicated with the suspicious IP, and any associated process and network activity.
lookFor: Process names, command lines, parent processes, number of affected endpoints, alert severity.
riskNote: Internal tool — no external submission risk.

name: Cortex XDR Hash Search
description: Search Cortex XDR for any endpoint that has seen or executed a file with this hash.
whyUse: Determine how widely a malicious file has been seen across your endpoint fleet.
lookFor: Number of affected endpoints, execution history, first/last seen, parent process context.
riskNote: Internal tool — no external submission risk.

name: Mimecast Message Trace
description: Search Mimecast for email messages from or to a specific sender or domain.
whyUse: Trace delivery and quarantine status of emails, identify how many users received messages from this sender or domain.
lookFor: Delivery status, recipient count, attachment hashes, URLs in body, rejection reasons.
riskNote: Internal tool — no external submission risk.

name: Palo Alto Traffic Log Search
description: Search Palo Alto firewall traffic logs for connections to/from a specific IP or domain.
whyUse: Pivot on firewall allow/deny logs to understand which internal assets communicated with the IOC and what applications were used.
lookFor: Allowed vs denied sessions, application identification, bytes transferred, session counts, policy names.
riskNote: Internal tool — no external submission risk.

name: Jira Search
description: Search Jira for existing tickets related to this IOC or indicator.
whyUse: Check if this IOC has been investigated previously or if there is an open incident already tracking it.
lookFor: Previous tickets, related incidents, analyst notes, resolution history, escalation status.
riskNote: Internal tool — no external submission risk.
